article.title: No seat at the table: Israel’s post-election message to its Palestinian citizens
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Netanyahu's party and the Israeli opposition are at an electoral stalemate that only an alliance with the Palestinian citizens of Israel can break, but neither camp is willing to extend their democratic ideals to the Arab lists who won 19 seats in the latest election.
